requirement: Use the existing persisted SyncPlan SyncRun SyncTask SyncAttempt and SyncTaskDependency model as the generic period coordinator.
rationale: Avoids introducing another orchestration system

requirement: Delegate IMAP transformation DuckDB and Parquet behavior to their dedicated components and persist only coordination state in the generic workflow.
rationale: Keeps task orchestration separate from domain implementation

requirement: Use a versioned closed set of task kinds from period_workflow_stages.csv rather than runtime-defined arbitrary workflows.
rationale: Keeps v1 pragmatic and testable

requirement: Use one UTC calendar month as the normal workflow period while allowing an explicit UTC half-open date range.
rationale: Aligns orchestration with monthly Parquet partitions

requirement: Represent every period as inclusive periodStart and exclusive periodEndExclusive instants in UTC.
rationale: Eliminates overlap and timezone ambiguity

requirement: Set partitionMonth only when boundaries exactly match one UTC calendar month.
rationale: Prevents incorrectly naming partial ranges as monthly archives

requirement: Discover IMAP UIDs rather than UUIDs and persist account mailbox UIDVALIDITY and UID on every per-email task.
rationale: Uses the durable server identity required for later fetches

requirement: Derive a deterministic task identity from run stage mailbox UIDVALIDITY UID and relevant schema or pipeline version.
rationale: Makes dynamic fan-out idempotent after crashes

requirement: Commit each discovery page and its newly created child tasks atomically before requesting the next page.
rationale: Avoids losing or duplicating fan-out work after interruption

requirement: Do not complete UID discovery until all server result pages are consumed and child-task uniqueness conflicts are resolved as existing work.
rationale: Provides a durable enumeration checkpoint

requirement: Fetch only headers flags dates size BODYSTRUCTURE and provider metadata during metadata.fetch.
rationale: Preserves the metadata-only sync boundary

requirement: Persist a normalized versioned intermediate result or integrity-checked locator before completing metadata.fetch.
rationale: Allows transformations to resume without repeating a successful network fetch

requirement: Create or reuse one EmailProcessingJob for each successfully fetched message and persist its ID on the coordinating SyncTask.
rationale: Connects generic orchestration to the durable transformation pipeline

requirement: Allow per-email processing tasks and independent transformers to run concurrently under separate bounded limits.
rationale: Provides throughput without unbounded network CPU or I/O work

requirement: Treat succeededWithWarnings as stable for period export while preserving optional transformer failures in analytical results.
rationale: Prevents optional work from blocking the whole period

requirement: Block period export when a required email-processing job failed unless policy explicitly excludes that message and records the exclusion.
rationale: Prevents silent partial analytical datasets

requirement: Create DuckDB export tasks only after discovery is complete and every included message has stable fetched metadata and a terminal processing job.
rationale: Defines a reproducible period snapshot

requirement: Upsert both email metadata using email_metadata_parquet_columns.csv and stable transformer results using duckdb_processing_export_tables.csv.
rationale: Produces a joinable analytical period

requirement: Run configurable idempotent batches until every eligible source version in the period is acknowledged in Core Data.
rationale: Allows restart without restarting the entire period

requirement: Verify logical keys source versions expected counts and absence of pending export claims before allowing archival.
rationale: Prevents incomplete Parquet publication

requirement: Archive automatically only after the UTC calendar month is closed; an explicit immutable historical range may be archived immediately.
rationale: Avoids racing normal changes in an open month

requirement: Archive only the immutable DuckDB exporting batch and never query changing live rows while writing a file.
rationale: Produces deterministic Parquet output

requirement: Write compatible email metadata and processing-result Parquet datasets for the same account mailbox and period.
rationale: Preserves their different row grains and join keys

requirement: Delete DuckDB exporting rows only after atomic Parquet publication verification and manifest commit.
rationale: Prevents data loss

requirement: Route changes discovered after archival into the DuckDB correction overlay and compact the affected monthly partition by policy.
rationale: Keeps old flags labels moves and expunges correct

requirement: On restart schedule persisted incomplete tasks whose dependencies are satisfied and never recreate completed task output unnecessarily.
rationale: Makes the whole multi-stage workflow crash-resumable

requirement: Inspect linked processing export and archive identifiers before retrying a coordinating task.
rationale: Lets subsystem idempotency close crash gaps

requirement: Apply task-kind-specific bounded retry policies and retain attempts and sanitized errors.
rationale: Distinguishes transient IMAP processing storage and archive failures

requirement: Mark the run blocked when credentials transformers schema compatibility or operator policy prevents safe progress.
rationale: Avoids destructive automatic guesses

requirement: Pause discovery fan-out when the number of unfinished per-email tasks exceeds a configured high-water mark.
rationale: Bounds Core Data rows memory and network pressure

requirement: Complete the run only after every required stage succeeds all counters reconcile and the account mailbox period checkpoint is committed.
rationale: Provides one durable end-to-end outcome

requirement: Keep task payloads small and versioned and never store message bodies credentials or large UID arrays in workflow rows.
rationale: Maintains Core Data as an operational store
